title: Steem / Hive / Blurt — Canonical Docs & Developer Portals
description: Doc-pointer companion to steem-hive-dev-repos.json. For each canonical doc/portal/README/wiki across Steem, Hive, and Blurt: a one-line 'what it teaches' and which of our 79 cloned reference repos covers it. MELEK is a Steem HF23 fork; these are upstream reference. Reader-facing rewrites live in site/witness-docs/.

hive-dev-portals.teaches: Canonical Hive developer portal: JS/Python tutorials, apps catalog, API reference, accounts/keys/RC/communities guides.
Chain mission, HIVE/HBD tokenomics, DPoS, 3-second-block social-blockchain model.
Reference TS/JS client: connect, read state, build & broadcast comment/vote/transfer/custom_json. Mirrors our src/chain/.
Official JS API (steem-js lineage): broadcast helpers, formatter, auth.
Lightweight complete JS lib (web+node): manual tx construction/signing; good for the wire format.
Modern zero-dependency TS SDK; clean op-building/signing reference.
Fork-resilient apps by indexing chain into Postgres with automatic fork-undo. Basis of a modern API node.
Operational guide to running a full HAF-based API node (Docker compose, Ubuntu sizing, services).
Social consensus-interpretation layer: feeds, follows, communities, bridge.* and condenser_api.* methods.
API caching/load layer (Rust/Actix) in front of hived.
Reference React front-ends (blog, wallet, communities, witness voting). denser is the modern Next.js rewrite. Our alpha condenser descends from this.
Canonical post-body renderer (Markdown + sanitization) so posts render identically and safely.
Calls hived C++ from Python/JS — low-level protocol/serialization reference.
High-level Hive automation library (watch chain, react to ops) — bot/observer pattern.
Official testnet tooling — snapshot mainnet, create a testnet, fund accounts. Relevant to MELEK testnet bring-up.

hive-keys-signing-auth.teaches: OAuth2-for-Hive: scoped access tokens, sign/broadcast on a user's behalf without holding keys. Pattern MELEK-Signer follows. Reference only.
Browser-extension key custody: dApps request signatures; keys never leave the extension.
QR/websocket auth so a phone app signs for a web session without exposing keys.
Standalone wallet daemon (HTTP/WS API) that holds keys and signs — the signer-service archetype.
Free anonymous account-creation service: operator-funded create_account so users self-register fee-free. Upstream of our faucet/signup.
Web tool to rotate account keys safely — the keys-explained / change-your-password UX.

hive-witness-ops.teaches: De-facto witness operator's toolkit (Someguy123): pricefeed, watcher, remote node-switch, CLI. Best how-to-run-a-witness reference; our witness/ is the spiritual port.
Focused price-feed publisher — what feed_publish does and how often. Mirrors witness/feed-publisher.mjs.
Running hived (witness/seed node) via Docker — node-ops baseline.
Missed-block alerting to chat — the monitoring half of witness ops (our witness/monitor.mjs).
Witness-health monitors — failover and missed-block detection patterns.
Auto-failover between backup signing nodes when the primary misses blocks.
Health-check RPC endpoints — what makes a node 'up' for a load balancer / API list.
Spreading API traffic across healthy nodes — front-of-node infrastructure.

steem-docs-libs.teaches: Original Graphene social-blockchain design (rewards pool, DPoS, SP/STEEM/SBD, 3s blocks). MELEK forks Steem HF23 — nearest upstream spec.
Original JS clients Hive forked from; same op set, useful for older tutorials.
Curated link-list of the whole Steem dev ecosystem — a map of where docs live.
xeroc base-layer libs — the Graphene primitives (tx format, signatures, object IDs) under every Steem/Hive/Blurt lib.
In-depth docs for the Python Graphene base library (tx building, signing, account/asset objects).

blurt-docs.teaches: Blurt = transfer-and-post, no-curation-rewards Steem fork — closest sibling to a single-purpose Graphene social chain.
Someguy123's Blurt node-in-Docker — same toolkit as Hive, retargeted; shows how little changes between forks.
Witness failover ported to Blurt — confirms witness-ops pattern is identical across forks.

python-cross-chain-libs.teaches: Comprehensive Python lib for HIVE and STEEM — wallet, ops, witness calls.
Modern maintained Python lib (beem successor) for Hive.
Minimal Python client — easiest read for a single RPC call.

engine-smt-docs.teaches: Official Engine developer wiki: system design, contract API, how custom_json drives a token sidechain. Reference for our engine/ (MELEK-Engine).
The Engine node (sidechain watching custom_json, maintaining token state).
Light JS client for the Engine JSON-RPC — how a front-end reads token balances/markets.
SCOT/Nitrous tribe-token reward docs — how a community token piggybacks post rewards.
Modern Python lib for Engine tokens.
